title: MongoTemplate, Criteria and Query
summary: Build explicit filters with validated values, bounded results and clear query choices.

sources.title: Engineering Digest: Mastering MongoTemplate, Criteria, and Query in Spring Boot MongoDB

richText: MongoTemplate is Spring Data’s API for explicit MongoDB operations. Inject the bean configured by Spring Boot into a service or repository component.
Criteria describes a condition. Query contains conditions and options such as sorting, projection and result limits.
Choose MongoRepository methods for simple fixed searches. Choose MongoTemplate when filters depend on runtime choices or you need explicit update operations.
The course filters users by sentimentAnalysis and email. Build business conditions separately from request validation. An email pattern alone cannot prove an address can receive mail.
is(value) performs equality matching. Conditions on different fields in this query combine with AND.
Keep field names and operators under application control. Pass validated values through Criteria rather than concatenating user input into a raw JSON query.
Regex means regular expression, a pattern used to match text. Use equality for an exact username lookup.
If a feature needs a literal prefix search, bound the input length and quote the prefix. Pattern.quote prevents regex symbols in the input from becoming pattern instructions.
Bound results and inspect query work
A limit caps one result set. It does not provide a full pagination design or guarantee stable ordering.
Choose deterministic sorting when paging. For equal sort values, add a unique field such as _id to break ties.
Projection selects only required fields. Use a response DTO, a separate object for API output, when partial data should not be treated as a complete persistent User.
An index helps MongoDB locate matching documents. Check indexes and explain output for real query patterns. Do not assume any regex query will use an index efficiently.
find returns an empty list when nothing matches. Distinguish that result from authentication, connection or query failures.
A query filter is not authorization by itself. Include the authenticated owner’s ID when reading private journal data.
